task_objective: Eliminate the transient Streamlit AppTest CI timeout flake across every AppTest.from_file call site.
design_decisions: Defined APPTEST_TIMEOUT once in tests/conftest.py and passed it explicitly to all 13 AppTest.from_file call sites.
Selected 30 seconds: ten times Streamlit's three-second default, providing ample CI-runner headroom without adding time to successful runs.
